description: Validate a JSON instance against an optional JSON Schema and return RFC 8785 canonical JSON plus SHA-256. Price: 0.01 USDC per successful call on Base via x402 (pass the signed payment in _meta['x402/payment']; failed calls are not charged). HTTP equivalent: POST https://json-canon-x402.fly.dev/v1/validate.

canonicalize.description: If true (default), return RFC 8785 JCS canonical JSON, its SHA-256 hex digest, and byte length.

instance.description: JSON value to validate. Any JSON type is accepted.

schema.description: JSON Schema to validate instance against. Optional. If omitted, the instance is accepted and only canonicalized.

name: validate_json
title: Validate + canonicalize JSON
